subject.title: Feature Request: Add parseMode config for Telegram channels

question: Should Telegram gain only a safe forced-plain opt-out alongside the current rich/HTML behavior, or a broader selectable renderer contract that also includes MarkdownV2 or raw HTML?
rationale: The choice determines the permanent config contract, precedence with `richMessages`, escaping rules, and whether untrusted model text may reach Telegram formatting parsers without the existing renderer.

options.title: Add safe plain mode
options.body: Preserve current defaults, add an inherited forced-plain option, and keep MarkdownV2 and raw HTML outside the supported contract.

options.title: Define full renderer modes
options.body: Design a broader enum covering plain, safe HTML, and MarkdownV2 with explicit escaping, precedence, migration, and end-to-end coverage.

options.title: Keep current controls
options.body: Decline another config surface and address remaining presentation defects through the existing renderer and `richMessages` behavior.

recommendation.title: Add safe plain mode
recommendation.body: Preserve current defaults, add an inherited forced-plain option, and keep MarkdownV2 and raw HTML outside the supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the HTML transition, Telegram configuration and send paths, and prior product review of this request.
